scope.quote:
TMLR’s objective is to publish original papers that contribute to the
understanding of the computational and mathematical principles that enable intelligence through learning

ai_policy.quote: LLMs may be used as general-purpose assistive tools.

rules.quote: information on appropriate action editors for the submission
rules.requirement: Recommend appropriate action editors in the submission system.

rules.quote: LLMs are not eligible for authorship.
rules.requirement: Do not list an LLM as an author.

rules.quote: we also require that authors mention explicitly in their submission that they have used this tool, as a footnote on the first page.
rules.requirement: Disclose LLM use in a first-page footnote when applicable.

rules.quote: submissions must be anonymized.
rules.requirement: Remove author-identifying information from the submission.

rules.quote: after the references (for proofs, derivations or complimentary results).
rules.requirement: Place any appendix after the references in the submission PDF.

rules.quote: Would some individuals in TMLR’s audience be interested in the findings of this paper
rules.requirement: Explain findings of interest to some of the TMLR audience.

rules.quote: They are aware the submission has been submitted to TMLR.
rules.requirement: Ensure every listed author knows the paper is submitted to TMLR.

rules.quote: They have made a substantial intellectual contribution to the work described in the submission.
rules.requirement: List as authors only people who meet TMLR’s intellectual contribution and other authorship criteria.

rules.quote: No authors may be added or removed after submission. There are no exceptions to this policy.
rules.requirement: Fix the complete author list at submission; do not add or remove authors later.

rules.quote: The exact set of authors must be listed on OpenReview, with active OpenReview profiles
rules.requirement: List all authors on OpenReview with active profiles at submission.

rules.quote: They take full responsibility for all content in the final published work.
rules.requirement: Ensure each author takes responsibility for the final work.

rules.quote:
a concise, concrete description of potential positive and
negative societal impact, as well as a discussion of possible mitigations.
rules.requirement: For a required broader impact statement, describe positive and negative impacts and possible mitigations.

rules.quote:
If their work carries a significant risk of harm, authors are required to include a Statement of
Broader Impact.
rules.requirement: Include a Statement of Broader Impact when the work carries significant risk of harm.

rules.quote: Are the claims made in the submission supported by accurate and convincing evidence?
rules.requirement: Support the paper’s claims with accurate and convincing evidence.

rules.quote: a submission should clearly communicate what it has found
rules.requirement: Communicate the findings and why they matter clearly.

rules.quote: funding, competing interests and any conflict of interest
rules.requirement: Report competing interests and conflicts during submission.

rules.quote:
It is forbidden to state a false
conflict in order to block potentially negative reviewers from an institution.
rules.requirement: Report only genuine conflicts of interest.

rules.quote:
papers that incorrectly claim novelty over existing
published work
rules.requirement: Avoid unsupported claims of novelty over published work.

rules.quote: funding, competing interests and any conflict of interest
rules.requirement: Report funding information during submission.

rules.quote: the ideas, claims and results found in submissions are human-sourced
rules.requirement: Ensure the scientific ideas, claims, and results are human-sourced.

rules.quote: information on appropriate action editors for the submission, as well as on human subjects reporting (IRB)
rules.requirement: Provide relevant human subjects or IRB information in the submission system.

rules.quote:
There should not be any reuse of written text,
figures or results
rules.requirement: Avoid reuse of text, figures, or results from archival or parallel submissions.

rules.quote:
we do not accept submissions that are
expanded versions of conference papers.
rules.requirement: Do not submit an expanded version of an archival conference paper.

rules.quote: is submitted to OpenReview in anonymized form
rules.requirement: Submit an anonymized manuscript through OpenReview.

rules.quote: not linking to another version that includes the authors' names.
rules.requirement: Do not link the anonymized submission to an identified preprint version.

rules.quote: a link provided to the previously rejected submission
rules.requirement: For a revised resubmission, link the previously rejected submission and describe changes.

rules.quote: All TMLR submissions, from the time of submission to final publication, are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
rules.requirement: Ensure submission can be licensed CC BY 4.0 from submission onward.

rules.quote:
Submissions must be PDF files generated using the
TMLR LaTeX stylefile
rules.requirement: Submit a PDF generated with the TMLR LaTeX style file and template.

rules.quote: All authors must have sufficient budget remaining for the year in order to make a submission.
rules.requirement: Confirm each author has sufficient annual submission quota.

rules.quote: material created by the authors that directly supports the submission content.
rules.requirement: Submit only author-created supplementary material directly supporting the paper.

rules.quote: up to 100MB of supplementary material
rules.requirement: Keep any submitted supplementary material within 100 MB.

rules.quote: supplementary material must be anonymized.
rules.requirement: Anonymize submitted supplementary material.

rules.quote: all supplementary materials must be in PDF or ZIP format.
rules.requirement: Submit supplementary materials only as PDF or ZIP files.

rules.quote: As of September 1, 2026, TMLR no longer considers survey papers for review.
rules.requirement: Do not submit a survey paper for review.

rules.quote: Any changes to the stylefile or template that alters the formatting, font, or layout of the manuscript may result in rejection without review.
rules.requirement: Keep the mandatory template formatting, font, and layout.
